description: Screened electrostatic potential along the nucleotide exit path in wild type and K46E/K114D, and the monopole versus base-dipole energy scales
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, requests, os
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
start,axis = np.load("ctx.npy")
cW=pd.read_csv("chargesWT.csv"); cM=pd.read_csv("chargesMUT.csv")

# --- Debye-Huckel screened Coulomb potential, bulk solvent, 150 mM 1:1 salt, 298 K ---
EPS=78.5; KAPPA=1/7.86; KCAL=332.06           # kcal*A/(mol*e^2)
kT=0.593                                      # kcal/mol at 298 K
def phi(points, c, exclude=()):
    sub=c[~c.resi.isin(exclude)]
    Q=sub.q.to_numpy(float); P=sub[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()
    d=np.linalg.norm(points[:,None,:]-P[None,:,:],axis=2); d=np.clip(d,1.0,None)
    return (KCAL/EPS)*(Q*np.exp(-KAPPA*d)/d).sum(1)     # kcal/(mol*e)

ts=np.arange(0,26.01,0.25); pts=start+np.outer(ts,axis)
pW, pM = phi(pts,cW), phi(pts,cM)
# contribution of residues 46 + 114 alone
pW46 = pW - phi(pts,cW,exclude=(46,114)); pM46 = pM - phi(pts,cM,exclude=(46,114))

# where does the path leave the protein envelope?
def parse(pid):
    rows=[]
    for line in open(f"pdb/{pid}.pdb"):
        if line.startswith("ATOM"):
            if line[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
            el=(line[76:78].strip() or "C").upper()
            if el=="H": continue
            rows.append((line[21],int(line[22:26]),float(line[30:38]),float(line[38:46]),float(line[46:54])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,columns="chain resi x y z".split())
pr=parse("6NO0"); pr=pr[pr.chain=="A"]
tree=cKDTree(pr[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy())
dmin=np.array([tree.query(p)[0] for p in pts])
t_mouth=ts[np.argmax(dmin>5.0)]               # first point >5 A from any protein atom
print(f"path leaves the protein envelope (>5 A clearance) at t = {t_mouth:.1f} A from the adenine centroid")

idx=np.argmin(np.abs(ts-t_mouth))
print(f"\nAt the mouth (t={ts[idx]:.1f} A):  phi_WT = {pW[idx]:+.3f} kcal/mol/e ({pW[idx]/kT:+.2f} kT/e), "
      f"phi_MUT = {pM[idx]:+.3f} ({pM[idx]/kT:+.2f} kT/e)")
dPhi=pM[idx]-pW[idx]
print(f"  delta phi (mut - WT) = {dPhi:+.3f} kcal/mol/e = {dPhi/kT:+.2f} kT/e")
print(f"  residues 46+114 alone contribute: WT {pW46[idx]:+.3f}, MUT {pM46[idx]:+.3f} kcal/mol/e "
      f"({(pM46[idx]-pW46[idx])/dPhi*100:.0f}% of the change)")
for q,lab in [(-2,"NDP (ADP/GDP)"),(-3,"NTP (ATP/GTP)")]:
    print(f"  monopole work change for {lab}, q={q}: {q*dPhi:+.2f} kcal/mol "
          f"(favourable for the mutant by {abs(q*dPhi):.2f} kcal/mol, identical for A and G)")

# --- field at the mouth and the base-dipole (selectivity) term ---
E=-np.gradient(pW,ts); Em=abs(E[idx])          # kcal/(mol*e*A)
D2eA=0.2082                                    # 1 Debye = 0.2082 e*A
mu_ade, mu_gua = 2.5*D2eA, 6.6*D2eA            # literature gas-phase dipoles
dmu=mu_gua-mu_ade
print(f"\nfield along the axis at the mouth |E| = {Em:.4f} kcal/(mol*e*A)")
print(f"  best-case (fully aligned) dipole energy difference guanine vs adenine = {dmu*Em:.4f} kcal/mol "
      f"= {dmu*Em/kT:.3f} kT")
# rotationally averaged (Keesom-like) term for a freely tumbling dipole
ua=-(mu_ade*Em)**2/(3*kT); ug=-(mu_gua*Em)**2/(3*kT)
print(f"  rotationally averaged difference = {abs(ug-ua):.5f} kcal/mol = {abs(ug-ua)/kT:.4f} kT")
print(f"  ratio monopole(ATP, q=-3) / best-case dipole selectivity = {abs(-3*dPhi)/(dmu*Em):.0f} x")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
ax[0].plot(ts,pW/kT,label="wild type (Lys46, Lys114)",lw=2)
ax[0].plot(ts,pM/kT,label="K46E/K114D",lw=2)
ax[0].axvspan(0,t_mouth,color="0.9",label="inside protein envelope")
ax[0].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.6); ax[0].set_xlabel("distance from adenine centroid along exit channel (A)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("electrostatic potential (kT/e)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("Potential along the nucleotide exit path\nDebye-Huckel, 150 mM, eps=78.5",fontsize=10)
qs=np.array([-2,-3]); w=0.35
ax[1].bar(np.arange(2)-w/2,qs*(pW[idx]),w,label="wild type")
ax[1].bar(np.arange(2)+w/2,qs*(pM[idx]),w,label="K46E/K114D")
ax[1].bar([2-w/2,2+w/2],[mu_ade*Em,mu_gua*Em],w,color=["#777","#bbb"])
ax[1].set_xticks([0,1,2]); ax[1].set_xticklabels(["NDP q=-2\n(monopole)","NTP q=-3\n(monopole)","base dipole\nade | gua"])
ax[1].set_ylabel("interaction energy at the mouth (kcal/mol)"); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title("Charge term is large and base-blind;\ndipole term is the only base-specific part",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
